question: Will Arthur Fils win the 2026 Men's US Open?
description:
The 2026 U.S. Open tennis tournament is scheduled for August 23 - September 13, 2026.

This market will resolve to the player that wins the 2026 U.S. Open Men’s Singles Tournament.

If at any point it becomes impossible for a listed player to win the 2026 U.S. Open Men’s Singles Tournament per the rules of the tournament, the corresponding market will resolve to “No”.

If the 2026 U.S. Open Men’s Singles Tournament is cancelled, postponed after October 31, 2026, or there is otherwise no winner declared within that timeframe, this market will resolve to “Other”.

The primary resolution source will be official information from the U.S. Open (https://www.usopen.org/index.html); however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

eventMetadata.context_description: Jannik Sinner’s knee injury withdrawal has shifted trader consensus sharply toward Carlos Alcaraz at 34.5% implied probability, reflecting the Spaniard’s strong 2026 hard-court results, Australian Open title, and career Grand Slam status as the defending US Open champion. Alexander Zverev at 20.1% benefits from consistent recent form and ranking proximity, while Novak Djokovic’s 9.4% accounts for his experience on the surface despite age. Emerging contenders like Ben Shelton (7.8%) and Taylor Fritz (5.5%) draw support from recent ATP results and home-crowd factors, with the field remaining competitive given typical Grand Slam variance in draw, fitness, and matchups.
